JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Babette, Germaine, Ruthe, Shan

Germaine here. To optimize task coverage and avoid overlaps, I encourage Babette and Shan to clarify their preferred tasks among ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::triage. This will help finalize our assignments efficiently.

Babette confirms interest in ISSUE-0001::review and ISSUE-0001::triage as potential tasks. To help finalize assignments and avoid overlaps, Babette would like to know Shan's preference between these two tasks since Germaine is focused on implement and Ruthe on docs. Babette aims to cover these moderate-effort critical tasks efficiently with her backend skills and 6 hours availability.
